field_updates.detail: Fig. 4 "Typical Instantaneous Forward Characteristics" (TJ = 25 C, 300 us pulse, 1 % duty), typical forward curve, vector-extracted read points (IF, VF): (0.01021 A, 0.6214 V), (0.14614 A, 0.7671 V), (0.44146 A, 0.8386 V), (1.26145 A, 0.9214 V), (1.87742 A, 0.9605 V), (2.6358 A, 1.0043 V), (4.45497 A, 1.1011 V); residuals mV: [-0.6, -0.1, 2.7, 1.2, -2.3, -3.0, 2.1] (rms 2.0, max 3.0) Method: Least-squares fit of VF = N*Vt*ln(IF/IS+1) + IF*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt=25.69 mV at 25 C, over 0.01 A to 4.45 A (7 of 11 polyline vertices; IF(AV) rating is 1 A). Points read from the PDF vector path of the curve (not a raster), axis calibrated to the plot frame/decade grid lines. The curve is drawn as an 11-vertex polyline; the vertices are used as read points. Vertices above 5 A depart from Shockley+RS (residual vs this fit: +8.9 mV@8.95 A, +23@11.8 A, +42@15.6 A, +147 mV@18.0 A), so they were excluded.
